capabilities.summary: Expose a bounded MCP stdio tool that invokes the local Codex CLI without a command shell.
useWhen: A trusted MCP host needs to delegate a coding request to an already installed Codex CLI.
doNotUseWhen: Codex is not installed or the requested working directory is outside the declared workspace root.
The caller expects Kim Service to route or finally approve the work.
permissions: Read and possibly modify files only according to the selected Codex sandbox inside the declared workspace root.
sideEffects: May launch a Codex child process.
May change workspace files when workspace-write is explicitly selected.

when: Before accepting any downstream Codex action requiring approval.

capabilities.summary: Expose a bounded MCP stdio tool that invokes the local Gemini CLI without shell command composition.
useWhen: A trusted MCP host needs a local Gemini review or analysis through the installed CLI.
doNotUseWhen: The caller requests automatic approval mode, unrestricted environment forwarding, or a working directory outside the workspace root.
permissions: Read files exposed by the Gemini CLI sandbox and declared workspace root.
sideEffects: May launch a Gemini child process.
May use a validated proxy only when the operator explicitly enables proxy forwarding.

when: Before enabling Gemini workspace mutation or proxy forwarding.
Before accepting any downstream action that changes the environment.

capabilities.summary: Plan, apply, and rollback project-scoped Claude command and Skill assets with hash receipts.
useWhen: A project owner wants the bundled Claude commands and private orchestration Skill installed into one explicit project root.
doNotUseWhen: The target is a user-wide configuration directory, is not an existing directory, or contains conflicting files without explicit replacement approval.
permissions: On explicit apply or rollback, write only beneath the selected project root.
sideEffects: Apply writes project-scoped Claude assets and a receipt.
Rollback restores receipt-backed files or removes files created by that receipt.

capabilities.summary: Provide ten upstream-derived Claude commands and a private orchestration Skill for explicit host-side use.
useWhen: A Claude host needs an explicit command for planning, generation, review, setup, or a multi-CLI workflow.
doNotUseWhen: A generic Kim Service capability should remain host-neutral, or the user has not approved file-changing command behavior.
permissions: Permissions are declared by each host command and remain subject to the host approval system.
sideEffects: Individual commands can request file writes or invoke MCP tools after host approval.

when: Before any command writes files, invokes a mutating tool, or updates project documentation.
